# Experiments (all numbers regenerated by the scripts; data status in brackets)

**E1 traffic distinguisher** [measured on the real implementation, CPython]. 3000 real vs 3000 cover frames; best
single-feature threshold (popcount, mean byte, chi-square) = **51.0 %** (optimistic for the adversary:
evaluated on training data). Baseline "event-driven, no cover": 100 % by construction (an event is visible).

**E2 typing rhythm** [SYNTHETIC: 300 operators, drift 8 %, intra-session CV 0.18; stress = x0.75 or x1.35 speed, CV x1.5].
Enrolment 12 sessions, AUC 0.917; z = 3 → FPR 2.0 %, TPR 51.7 %; z = 4 → FPR 0.4 %, TPR 28.0 %. No real coerced data used.
Consequence: HOLD (delay and out-of-band confirmation), never a hard block. Of 399 demo seeds, 383 give all six
expected outcomes; the demo uses seed 1 (first of them).

**E3 cost of cover** [analytic latency model + exact frame size]: 64 B per slot. 1000 ms slot → 512 bit/s, mean wait 502 ms.

**E5 limit** [measured]: with the terminal MAC key and one captured auth frame, a 6-digit PIN is found offline in 482 916 trials, 1.9 s.

**Wokwi (ESP32, MicroPython 1.21 firmware)** [real simulation]: six scenarios gave exactly the host verdicts and
behavioural scores (S1 8; S2 66/4; S3 157/27; S4 DROP_REPLAY; S5 DROP_TAMPER; S6 FAIL×3→LOCKED).
OLED frames captured pixel-exact (`assets/fig_oled_real.png`).
